name: StoreVisitGeoCheckIn
tagline: Store Visit Geo Check-In records a store or site visit with proof of presence.
description: Store Visit Geo Check-In records a store or site visit with proof of presence. It finds the phone's position (no map service or API key), shows on a radar how far and in which direction you are from the store, compares that with the store's geofence and the GPS accuracy, and then lets you check in, take breaks and check out. Exceptions - checking in outside the fence, a poor GPS fix, no location, leaving before the minimum visit time - are either blocked, allowed with a reason code, or simply flagged, depending on the policy your app maker chose.
features: Locate the device (no map API key), see distance
Bearing and GPS accuracy on a radar against the store's geofence
Check in (blocked, reason-coded or allowed when outside the fence or the fix is poor)
Live on-site timer with minimum-visit progress, breaks
Check-out with a fresh fix and early-leave reason, visit log
Summary and outputs/events for Power Fx and flows
Keyboard and touch operable, phone layout
